decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's strategy through a combination of removal spells, discard effects, and powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. By controlling the board and hand of your opponent, you can dictate the pace of the game and ultimately overwhelm them with powerful, hard-to-answer threats. The key is to maintain a balance between disruption and aggression, using cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to apply pressure while keeping your opponent on the back foot.

The main focus of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to swarm the board with small creatures like Generous Visitor and Kami of Transience, buff them with cards like Ossification and Audacity, and protect them with Calix, Guided by Fate. The deck also utilizes The Ozolith to move counters around and keep the pressure on the opponent. With cards like Teachings of the Kirin and Commune with Spirits providing card advantage and Weaver of Harmony adding mana consistency, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and aggressive plays.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on removal spells and graveyard recursion to control the board and outvalue the opponent. It utilizes cards like Reckoner Bankbuster, Make Disappear, and Go for the Throat to deal with threats, while also including cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse for additional value. The deck aims to control the game through card advantage and removal, eventually overwhelming the opponent with its powerful creatures and spells. The mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the deck while also allowing for consistency in casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to control the board through a combination of removal spells and powerful creatures, such as Bloodtithe Harvester, Graveyard Trespasser, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also utilizes Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Reckoner Bankbuster to disrupt the opponent's strategy and generate card advantage. With a mix of removal, disruption, and powerful threats, the deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent to secure victory in the game.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of counter spells, removal spells, and hand disruption. It also utilizes powerful creatures like Liliana of the Veil, Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, and Ertai Resurrected to control the board and pressure the opponent. The deck features a mix of control elements to deal with a variety of threats while maintaining card advantage through spells like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Bloodtithe Harvester. With a solid mana base and a strong late-game plan, this deck aims to outlast and outvalue the opponent.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on utilizing a variety of removal and counter spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also leveraging graveyard recursion and card advantage through cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent in the late game, ultimately grinding them out and securing victory through attrition and card advantage. It also contains a small reanimation package to bring back key threats from the graveyard for added resilience and pressure.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, and Bloodtithe Harvester, and disruptive cards like Duress and Invoke Despair. The deck aims to dominate the board while steadily depleting the opponent's resources, ultimately overwhelming them with threats like Reckoner Bankbuster and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Chandra, Hope's Beacon provides additional value and card advantage, while lands like Blackcleave Cliffs and Sulfurous Springs ensure consistency in mana production.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced aggressive strategy using low mana cost creatures in a White Weenie archetype. With a focus on quickly building a board presence, the deck includes cards that can support each other and maintain pressure on the opponent. By utilizing efficient creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, as well as spells like Ossification and Invasion of Gobakhan, the goal is to quickly build a strong board presence and push for early victories.

The deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful creatures to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It aims to eliminate threats with cards like Go for the Throat and Abrade, while also protecting itself with Negate and Blot Out. The deck can generate card advantage with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Invoke Despair, and finish off the game with powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester. The mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the spells and creatures in the deck.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with aggressive creatures like Vampire Socialite and Voldaren Thrillseeker, supported by powerful removal spells like Go for the Throat and Pile On. The key strategy is to apply constant pressure on the opponent, overwhelming them with a steady stream of threats while disrupting their game plan with removal. By efficiently utilizing the creatures and spells in the deck, the goal is to quickly deplete the opponent's life total and secure victory before they can stabilize or mount a defense.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board and outlast the opponent through a combination of removal spells, powerful creatures, and life gain. By using cards like Ossification and Lay Down Arms, the player can neutralize threats while building up their own board presence with creatures like The Wandering Emperor and Serra Paragon. The inclusion of cards like Breach the Multiverse and The Restoration of Eiganjo also allows for flexibility and versatility in dealing with different situations. Ultimately, the goal is to establish dominance and outvalue the opponent in long, grindy games.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's plans and taking control of the game by using powerful Rakdos creatures and removal spells. The strategy involves using cards like Etali and Sheoldred to dominate the battlefield, while also utilizing cards like Reckoner Bankbuster and Invoke Despair to disrupt your opponent's hand and resources. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down to eliminate threats. Overall, the goal is to outlast your opponent and establish dominance through a combination of control and aggression.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of removal spells, discard effects, and powerful creatures. The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's plans by destroying their creatures and emptying their hand through cards like Cut Down, Go for the Throat, Invoke Despair, and Abrade. It also utilizes the graveyard with cards like Soul Transfer, Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, and Graveyard Trespasser to gain advantage and apply pressure. The deck includes a mix of versatile removal spells, resilient creatures, and dual lands to ensure a consistent and aggressive control strategy.

This Rakdos Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through hand disruption with cards like Duress, as well as removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser provide graveyard recursion and pressure. Bloodtithe Harvester and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker generate card advantage and help maintain control of the game. The deck also includes Chandra, Hope's Beacon for additional card draw and removal. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can close out with cards like Light Up the Night and Breach the Multiverse.

This deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells and powerful creatures to control the game and disrupt your opponent's strategy. With a mix of efficient removal like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, along with heavy hitters like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Reckoner Bankbuster, the goal is to maintain board control and outvalue your opponent. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides additional card advantage, while Invoke Despair can disrupt your opponent's hand. The deck also includes some direct damage options like Light Up the Night and Chandra, Hope's Beacon for additional reach.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful reanimation spells to bring back creatures from the graveyard, combining them with combo pieces to create a devastating board presence. The strategy involves setting up the graveyard with cards like The Cruelty of Gix and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, then using cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to bring back high-impact creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Etali, Primal Conqueror. The deck also includes removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down to control the board and disruption spells like Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan.
